note: Rule inspection (rule 7) from the 16:45 rivers run, three findings with evidence for T-0021. (1) Independence (rules 2, 15): the 11 reviews of T-0009's work (grok 12:29, 13:27, 15:20, 16:18; grok-gait 14:30, 15:15, 16:08, 16:15) and its plan confirmation path were all by Grok Bot roles reviewing each other; 'never approve your own work' is satisfied by name but not by agent. Proposal: an approve or approve-plan must come from a different agent family (grok*, claude, codex, agy) than the owner. (2) Rule 9 loop handoffs: the file name tasks/handoffs/<agent>-loop.md assumes one session per agent. Two claude sessions ran (claude/loop 11:20-14:40 and claude/water from 16:45), so this run had to add its section to claude-loop.md on a second branch, which will conflict when both branches merge. Proposal: <agent>-loop.md gets merge=union in .gitattributes (as notes/*.md has), or the name carries the branch. (3) Evidence paths (rules 6, 11): T-0009's handoff cites /workspace/rabbit/compare-run6.jpg, which does not exist on omen, so a reviewer cannot check the gate image. Proposal: recording and reference paths in a handoff must exist on omen or in the repo.
